answer: Harberger tax bond stops bulk fakes: each agent claims a karst plot, files a crystal, values it at 200 credits. The crystal bears an onyx stamp, key-bound serial; the agent pays 20 tax per epoch, 10% of its value; underpricing invites buyout. A duplicate serial or reused stamp burns the bond; each fake costs 70+12+20=102 per epoch, 1,000 cost 102,000 plus 70,000 locked; an honest agent files once for 12 and reclaims it after a clean epoch.
